key_insight: GMMag generates crystal structures with site-resolved magnetic moments and uses Gaussian-mixture sampling to target desired chemistry and magnetism without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The workflow could accelerate magnetic-material discovery by targeting candidate properties while estimating how many distinct, qualifying chemical formulas a finite generation budget will yield.
method: Conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and transformer decoder.
Gaussian-mixture sampling retargets generation toward selected chemical and magnetic objectives.
Yield modeling accounts for repeated chemical formulas that limit distinct-candidate accumulation.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates architecture, magnetic-moment representations and sampling choices, tests yield prediction in two separate ten-million-draw runs, and identifies Nd-containing candidates with previously absent formulas, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
watch_item: Higher screening pass rates need not produce more distinct formulas, and the reported candidate properties do not establish experimental synthesizability or magnetic performance.
paper_title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
